slides.headline: Is it a sin to feel anxious?
slides.sub: What Scripture actually says, in four short slides.

slides.heading: Feeling anxious isn’t a sin.
body: The psalmists, Paul, and Jesus Himself in the garden of Gethsemane felt deep distress.
Scripture’s invitation is to bring that anxiety to God rather than carry it alone.

slides.quote: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
slides.note: Paul doesn’t say “stop feeling anxious.” He gives you something to do with it: turn each worry into a request.

slides.quote: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
slides.note: “Casting” is a strong word. You don’t hand worries over gently; you throw them, because they’re too heavy to hold.

slides.close: Bring one worry to Him tonight.
